The '''Lesser Sarlacc of Dathomir''',<ref name="SWG:LSoD">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Badge: "Lesser Sarlacc of Dathomir"}}</ref> also known as the '''Dathomir Sarlacc''',<ref name="SWG:DS" /> was a [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] pit located in the [[Asou Dankal]] region of the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Its origins were unknown, though it was considered almost as frightening as its larger relative in the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Little was understood on the ways sarlaccs grew or lived due to the great dangers involved in studying them, which was why it was advised a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] be present whenever someone visited this site.

==Behind the scenes==
The Dathomir Sarlacc was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
